full_prompt_en: A square black and white fashion photograph shows a face in very close view, framed by dark hair and a pale printed border. The head tilts toward the lower left, and loose glossy strands fall diagonally across the upper face so that the eyes remain hidden. One hand rises from the lower left and supports the cheek, with the forearm entering along the bottom edge. The nose emerges from shadow near the center, while softly parted dark lips become the clearest feature in the lower middle of the image. A luminous cheek and jaw occupy the right half, narrowing into a neck that disappears into a plain black top at the lower right. Around the head, the background stays almost completely black, with only thin gray separations where hair catches light. The white border is narrow along the top and left, then broadens below the image like the margin of a photographic print. Soft directional light from the upper left picks out the hair's curved highlights and bleaches parts of the cheek nearly white. Strong shadow covers the obscured eye area and the space beneath the nose, creating abrupt transitions between black, gray, and white. Fine photographic grain is visible in the paler areas, while the darkest passages absorb many small details. The framing crops the head closely at the top and right, increasing the tension of the downward tilt and making the supporting hand part of the composition. No legible lettering interrupts the print. The overall composition is intimate and graphic, using concealed eyes, luminous planes, and dense black to create a moody editorial image.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白时尚摄影作品以极近的视角呈现一张面孔，深色头发与浅色照片边框围住画面。头向左下方倾斜，松散而带光泽的发束斜落在上半张脸前，使双眼被遮住。一只手从左下方抬起托住脸颊，前臂沿下缘进入画面。鼻子在中央附近从阴影中显出，微微张开的深色嘴唇成为下方中部最清楚的五官。明亮的面颊和下颌占据右半部，向下收成脖颈，在右下方融进朴素的黑色上衣。头部周围的背景几乎全黑，只有头发接住光时出现纤细的灰色分界。上方和左侧的白色边框较窄，在图像下方变宽，如相纸的留边。柔和的定向光从左上方照来，挑出发丝弯曲的亮线，并把部分面颊照得近乎纯白。强阴影盖住被遮挡的眼部区域和鼻下空间，使黑、灰、白之间产生突然的过渡。较浅处可见细微摄影颗粒，最暗处则吞没许多小细节。画框从上方和右侧紧紧裁切头部，加强低垂姿态的张力，也使托脸的手成为构图的一部分。画面没有可读文字。整体构图亲密而图形化，以隐藏的眼睛、明亮的平面和浓重黑色形成情绪低沉的编辑影像。
style_prompt_en: Black and white photographic contrast is pushed toward inky dark fields and broad near white highlights, with only narrow bands of middle gray joining them. Soft directional illumination skims selected curves, producing glossy streaks and luminous planes while adjacent details disappear into shadow. Fine visible grain and slight tonal roughness keep the image feeling printed and tactile. Cropping is tight and asymmetrical, letting large dark shapes press against an illuminated focal area. Edges switch between razor clear high contrast boundaries and soft dissolves inside the darkest values. Diagonal sweeps interrupt the otherwise compact arrangement, guiding the eye across the light rather than through deep space. A plain pale border can frame the dense interior as a photographic print without adding decorative typography. The overall effect is stark, sensual, and editorial, using restraint of color and selective visibility to give a simple arrangement considerable tension.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白摄影反差被推向墨色暗场与宽阔的近白高光，只有狭窄的中灰地带连接两者。柔和定向光擦过选定的曲面，形成带光泽的条痕和明亮平面，邻近细节却消失在阴影里。可见的细颗粒和轻微调子粗糙感使图像带有相纸般的触感。裁切紧密而不对称，让大片深色形状挤向受光焦点。边缘在高反差的锐利分界与最深明度里的柔软消散之间切换。斜向走势打断原本紧凑的排列，引导视线横过亮部，而非深入远景。朴素的浅色边框可将浓密的内部画面围成一张照片，不添加装饰字样。整体效果鲜明、感性而富有编辑影像气质，以克制的色彩和选择性的可见性赋予简洁布局相当强的张力。
theme_en: High-contrast black-and-white close-up with the eyes hidden by hair
theme_zh: 头发遮住眼睛的高反差黑白面部特写
name: Ezra Petronio
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
